name: SARABAPASS SideA
source:
Main character lives in the city that has paranormal UFO activity. This rainy season he meets three girls that help to lift the heaviness of the clouds.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公生活的城市里，时有超自然的UFO活动。在这个雨季，他遇见了三名少女，她们帮助他驱散了沉重的阴霾。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
